item.title: Deep Learning Modeling Textbook: Reproducible Experiments for Manufacturing Data
item.description:
Project resources

The public learning repository and its evidence status.

  • GitHub repositorygithub.com/HeungJAELEE/Deep_Learning_Text_book

No separate public report is registered. This article remains a learning and experiment-design document and does not add unsupported implementation or model-performance claims.

Project at a Glance

Deep Learning Modeling Textbook is a personal learning and practical validation project for organizing data preprocessing, model training, evaluation, and reproducibility as one traceable workflow. Instead of stopping at isolated tutorial code, the project defines a modeling standard that can be reused when new data arrives: frame the problem, run a controlled experiment, and explain the result.
